updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Expansion: Safeguard Sensitive Data in Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is being expanded to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data detected in prompts for external web searches. This real-time control helps organizations block data leakage risks when users interact with generative AI features.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot Extended to Government Clouds
updates.summary: DLP protection for Copilot prompts containing sensitive data is now rolling out to government cloud environments, preventing responses and blocking sensitive data from being used for grounding in searches. This ensures compliance requirements are met even when users leverage AI assistants in restricted cloud deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard for DLP alerts will display Mean Time to Acknowledge (MTTA), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR) metrics, allowing admins to define custom SLAs by severity level and track operational performance. This helps compliance teams measure and improve their incident response efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Rule-Based Alert Auto-Resolution and Tagging
updates.summary: Admins will soon be able to define rules that automatically resolve or tag DLP alerts based on business criteria—for example, auto-resolving low-severity mail-only alerts to trusted domains or labeling alerts by department. This reduces alert fatigue and improves triage efficiency.

updates.title: Sensitivity Labels Extended to Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Organizations will be able to apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same labels configured for Microsoft 365 groups and sites, with no additional label setup required. This extends classification and governance controls to identity-based group objects.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Capacity Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is increasing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, allowing organizations to apply sensitivity labels and protection to more data at rest faster. This improvement helps organizations prepare their data estate for governance and Copilot integration with better labeling coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Enriched Audit Data for Matched Rules
updates.summary: DLP audit records in Exchange Online will now display enriched metadata including sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, and recipient information alongside Sensitive Information Type matches. This expanded audit visibility helps admins investigate policy violations and tune rules more effectively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM: Archive OneDrive and SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Admins will be able to include archiving actions within data retention policies for SharePoint Online and OneDrive, automatically moving inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining discoverability. This reduces storage costs without compromising compliance or data governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM: Hard Delete Capability for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: A new secure priority cleanup workflow will enable hard deletion of content from OneDrive and SharePoint after it has been retained and reviewed, moving beyond the standard 93-day recycle bin retention. This helps organizations permanently remove data when required by compliance policies while maintaining safeguards against inadvertent loss.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62825: Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Azure Key Vault allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over the network. Organizations using Key Vault for identity and access management should apply the latest security updates immediately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56191: Microsoft Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Microsoft Exchange Online permits unauthorized attackers to tamper with data over the network. This vulnerability directly impacts email security and data integrity for organizations relying on Exchange for secure communications.

updates.title: CVE-2026-58275: Azure DNS Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authorization controls in Azure DNS allow unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. This vulnerability could enable attackers to manipulate DNS resolution and intercept traffic for identity and access services.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62835: Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Online Services enables unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over the network. This vulnerability could expose tenant data, credentials, or configuration details across Microsoft cloud services.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56163: Azure Kubernetes Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure Kubernetes Service allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over the network. Organizations running AKS clusters should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized access to workloads and control planes.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56160: Azure Red Hat OpenShift Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Azure Red Hat OpenShift (ARO) allows an authorized attacker to escalate their privileges beyond their intended scope. Organizations using ARO should review access controls and apply available security updates.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: A new unified alert dashboard combines the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing analysts to manage both classic and agent-triaged alerts in one location with expanded user profile details from Microsoft Entra. Enhanced note capabilities across alerts and cases improve collaboration and documentation of investigations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP is integrating with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, blocking sensitive data from flowing to untrusted cloud applications through browsers, APIs, and add-ins. This capability helps prevent data leakage to shadow IT and generative AI platforms by enforcing DLP policies at network ingress and egress points.
